limitations: Profiles are conditional review selections, NOT proven brand-to-program, card-code or transaction eligibility mappings.
PREPAID and COMMERCIAL overlays remain unresolved per network; closed-loop SVC rules must not be copied to open-loop prepaid.
Commercial usage is orthogonal to funding program. Card presence, entry mode and channel are separate dimensions.
eWIC has no financial card-code assignment in the current 36-code catalog; do not manufacture one.
STAR 020/011 are review candidates for original/follow-up message contexts, not interchangeable codes.
Generic Debit has no resolved network; generic EBT has no resolved benefit provider. Never infer these from DB or EB receipts.

flows.name: Authorization to completion

flows.name: Purchase to reversal
flows.scope: Original POS/CAT versus mail/phone context must be preserved

flows.name: Timeout to TOR to next financial request
flows.scope: Eligible 0/4/6 purchase, not automatic completion eligibility; debit POS/CAT capture TOR restrictions apply
legs: Next financial request on same device

flows.name: Stored value operation to cancellation
flows.scope: Previous stored value gift-card transaction; preserve original amount and undo corresponding totals

flows.name: Stored value failure to timeout cancellation
flows.scope: SVC device or communications failure; amount is client-configured
legs: SVC operation fails or times out

flows.name: eWIC benefits inquiry to purchase completion
flows.scope: Dedicated eWIC nonfinancial message family, not generic credit authorization

flows.name: eWIC authorization to cancellation
flows.scope: Timeout or customer cancellation requires eWIC Authorization Cancellation

flows.name: eWIC purchase to reversal to next eWIC request
flows.scope: Late/missing purchase response; origin device waits for reversal response regardless of response code
legs: Next eWIC transaction after reversal response

flows.name: Visa estimated and incremental authorization
flows.scope: 2026-3 Appendix AE eligible merchants; incremental legs optional/repeatable; second initial only for rollover

questions.question: Provide authoritative network/program identity, BIN/IIN range version where applicable, processor metadata, and explicit mappings between Section 5, brand and Appendix E card type. Non-card services need provider/program identity, not fabricated BIN evidence.
questions.evidenceNeeded: Versioned identity/routing contract; mismatch handling; environment and effective date.

questions.question: For the seven named networks plus separate generic Debit and EBT groups, confirm each selected program, transaction/ordered flow and card-code combination. Supply missing network-specific rules, including Discover, Diners Club and JCB exceptions. Resolve unassigned shared-library requirements and prepaid/commercial applicability; do not copy closed-loop SVC rules to open-loop prepaid. Classification and receipt labels do not establish eligibility.
questions.evidenceNeeded: Per-leg source-backed eligibility policy, merchant configuration, restrictions and approved scope; funding versus commercial usage and separate presence/entry/channel decisions.

questions.question: Confirm entry-mode, PIN, token/EMV companion-data requirements and card-status/expiry actions by processing context. Resolve Amex track-preference wording between 10.1.1.2 and 10.1.8.2.
questions.evidenceNeeded: Applicable source profile, device capability, encryption/EMV validation evidence, boundary and exception decisions.

questions.question: Confirm currency/amount mapping, discounts, cashback, partial-approval eligibility, requested versus approved reversal/TOR amounts and response outcomes by product.
questions.evidenceNeeded: Versioned arithmetic/rounding policy and synthetic or redacted request/response oracle pairs.

questions.question: Confirm timers, late-response handling, per-route TOR retries, same-device ordering, duplicate completion, correlation and composed authorization-completion-void behavior.
questions.evidenceNeeded: Transport-specific profile, source conflict decisions and synthetic lifecycle traces including failure/retry boundaries.

questions.owner: Stored value / loyalty / check / fleet program owners
questions.question: Confirm program-specific operation payloads, state changes, totals, authorizer configuration and required external petroleum/fleet contracts. Supply RBC lookup and TransArmor registration contracts.
questions.evidenceNeeded: Versioned program documentation and per-operation synthetic before/after state and host oracle evidence.

questions.question: Confirm benefit subtype and eWIC message/prompt mapping, PIN exceptions, voucher/HIP products, product/balance data and cancellation/reversal sequencing. Do not map eWIC onto generic credit flows.
questions.evidenceNeeded: Program/version/environment, exact message families, product fixtures, receipts and response traces.

questions.question: Confirm receipt rendering and redaction per product, including premium-gift PAN masking exception; resolve retention/access policy without storing full track/PIN data.
questions.evidenceNeeded: Approved receipt templates, data handling/retention rules and masked rendering evidence.

questions.question: Provide downstream clearing, settlement and reconciliation contracts and correlation keys. Protocol-valid approval is not proof of settlement.
questions.evidenceNeeded: Versioned interface schema, synthetic end-to-end settlement evidence and exception/reconciliation policy.

questions.owner: BA / release and incremental authorization owners
questions.question: Review Visa Appendix AE merchant scope, 7/14-day windows, rollover and continuity. Decide adoption of separate 2026-4 Appendix AF for Discover/Visa/Mastercard/Amex and resolve AF Transaction ID versus Table 82 Terminal Transaction Number.
questions.evidenceNeeded: Authorized release decision, source-version-specific rules, field mapping, timestamp/timezone policy and independent host/state evidence.

rules.statement: Keep Section 5 payment taxonomy, named brand/provider, financial card type and receipt ID separate. Neither credit code 020 nor receipt text proves network identity or transaction eligibility.
checks: Reject a claimed supported network/flow with no per-leg eligibility evidence.
Require trusted identity evidence appropriate to card or non-card service.
rules.expected: Missing or conflicting identity/policy remains REVIEW_REQUIRED; do not create an executable supported-policy rule.

rules.statement: Use Account Number Element 2, Card Discretionary Block Element 12, Approval Number Element 5, Approved Amount Element 6 and Sequence Number Element 86 in their applicable message contexts.
checks: Do not use Elements 24, 51, 6 or 80 as replacements for account, expiry, approval or sequence.
Validate account/track/token/encrypted representations under their declared profile.
rules.expected: Wrong field mapping fails the applicable field check; no universal numeric-only account composite rule.

rules.statement: Financial Prompt Codes combine a transaction character and three-digit financial card code; special three-character prompts and Table Load codes are separate namespaces. Specialized Appendix G codes require their own operation contracts.
checks: Preserve leading zeroes and transaction-code case.
Do not feed all 23 codes into the legacy 13-code financial oracle.
Keep code 9 Card Type 00/81-97 notation reconciliation open.
rules.expected: Classification passes only within its namespace; unresolved composition and operation contracts remain REVIEW_REQUIRED.

rules.statement: Select the source-defined message family before validating Element 55, Element 63, Segment 100 and conditional companion segments; count actually serialized segments, not arbitrary JSON objects.
checks: Apply financial Segment 100 rules only to financial messages.
Check required companion fields and exact wire layout for the selected profile.
rules.expected: Structural validity alone never proves network acceptance or converter readiness.

rules.statement: Apply source-specific widths and two assumed decimals to Fuel Amount 41, Nonfuel Amount 58, Tax Amount 99 and Approved Amount 6. Amex amount-width exceptions must not be copied to all networks.
checks: Check applicable presence, widths, requested/approved amount and decimal representation.
Review reconciliation, currency, cashback and discounts separately.
rules.expected: Field-format results are separate from arithmetic and host acceptance; unresolved policy stays REVIEW_REQUIRED.

rules.statement: Interpret Element 83 by transaction context: 0 purchase/capture approval, 2 authorization-only approval, 1 communications-test approval but decline for other transactions; F identifies applicable partial approvals.
checks: Do not interpret response 1 as universal approval.
Require response provenance and matching request context.
rules.expected: No issuer, balance, clearing or settlement outcome is inferred from a syntactically valid response code.

rules.statement: Device credit processing performs expiry validation; manual expiry uses MMYY in Element 12. Preserve the separate authorization transmission requirement even for expired cards.
checks: Test valid, expired and 1249 boundary cases.
Do not copy credit expiry rejection into debit, EBT, SVC or loyalty.
rules.expected: Exact rejection/timezone action requires an approved context-specific policy.

rules.statement: For supported credit partial-approval contexts, indicator 1 enables response F with Approved Amount 6 and remaining-balance tender handling. Indicator 5 is Amex prepaid balance-only, not generic partial approval.
checks: Gate merchant/network eligibility.
For partial-approved original transactions, distinguish reversal approved amount from TOR amount wording; resolve any ambiguous source wording before execution.
rules.expected: Do not equate reversal of a partially approved original with permission for arbitrary partial reversal.

rules.statement: Amex MSR/MSD AFD transactions require Track 1, including Track 1 encryption target when encrypted. General track-preference wording differs between 10.1.1.2 and 10.1.8.2 and requires profile review.
checks: Check Amex AFD-specific Track 1 presence under the applicable encryption profile.
Do not universalize another brand's default Track 2 rule.
rules.expected: AFD requirement is source-linked; non-AFD precedence interpretation remains REVIEW_REQUIRED.

rules.statement: Appendix G distinguishes Mastercard preauthorization for authorization/completion/auth cancellation from final authorization for sale/reversal/return/void of return, with stated 30-day versus 7-day protection and hold limits.
checks: Keep authorization classification separate from transaction-code recognition.
Require applicable current network/source policy before enforcing hold behavior.
rules.expected: Mastercard authorization context is not automatically reused for Visa, Discover, Amex or other labels.

rules.statement: When processed as debit, do not perform device expiry validation; request online authorization regardless of expiry.
checks: Exercise expired-card online authorization without a copied credit rejection.
Keep routing/issuer response independent.
rules.expected: Local expiry logic must respect debit processing context, not merely the card's printed brand.

rules.statement: Standard debit processing requires encrypted DUKPT PIN entry except Purchase Reversal; manual entry is not allowed. PINless and signature-debit processing are separate source profiles.
checks: Reject manual entry in the standard debit profile.
Apply the source PIN exception only to the stated transaction.
rules.expected: Do not extend this PIN/manual-entry rule to PINless, signature, EBT or credit by label alone.

rules.statement: A debit completion is processed once and cannot be reversed or processed again. If no response, resend on the next dial attempt or 30 minutes, whichever first; response 1/decline 24 means already captured and totals are treated approved.
checks: End completion retries on any response.
Do not generate TOR for unsupported debit POS/CAT capture/completion contexts.
rules.expected: Duplicate-completion recovery differs from ordinary purchase TOR; eligibility remains context-gated.

rules.statement: PINless requires supported network and Track 2; EMV uses US Common Debit AID with No CVM and No PIN Block. The base no-PIN threshold is <=50.00 with specific-BIN POS Plus expansion, not a universal current cap.
checks: Exclude cashback, FSA, AFD MCC 5542, unknown-final-amount and SAF contexts under this profile.
Treat listed PINless TOR separately from standard debit TOR restrictions.
rules.expected: Availability/BIN/amount policy is versioned and reviewed; do not reject every amount above 50.00 or apply blanket debit TOR bans.

rules.statement: Signature debit is a distinct supported-network processing profile and supports manual, swipe, contact and contactless entry; it must not inherit standard PIN-debit manual-entry prohibition.
checks: Require network availability and single/dual-message profile evidence.
Review source-specific transaction, cashback, follow-up and partial-approval restrictions.
rules.expected: STAR receipt classification alone does not prove signature-debit eligibility.

rules.statement: STAR signature debit single/dual message is limited to US/territories and USD 840, excludes cashback, recharge/activation/inquiry and eCommerce. Single-message additionally requires card-present full stripe/chip data, no keyed/MOTO, unchanged final amount and source-defined MCC exclusions.
checks: Apply single-message restrictions in addition to the general signature-debit profile.
Do not infer a routed fallback network from formatting alone.
rules.expected: Generic signature-debit manual-entry support does not override STAR single-message restrictions.

rules.statement: EBT processing does not perform device expiry validation. PIN exceptions are food voucher, food reversal and cash-benefit reversal; manual entry is supported with PIN rules and expiry prompt/default 1249.
checks: Test tender-specific PIN exceptions.
Do not substitute the credit expiry/manual-entry profile.
rules.expected: Food, cash benefits and eWIC are distinct profiles; no blanket EBT-without-PIN approval.

rules.statement: Print returned EBT ending balances; omit a balance line if that balance was not returned. Print zero only when the authorizer actually returns zero.
checks: Distinguish missing, zero and nonzero balances.
Review tender amounts, voucher/HIP fields and declined-receipt rules.
rules.expected: Missing balance must not become a fabricated zero balance.

rules.statement: eWIC uses dedicated authorization/benefits inquiry, balance inquiry, completion and cancellation/reversal operations; Return transactions are not supported in this source profile.
checks: Do not treat eWIC operations as generic credit code pairs.
Require reversal response before additional eWIC transactions from the originating device; retry if no response.
rules.expected: eWIC sequencing and product/balance semantics require the dedicated message contracts.

rules.statement: Section 10.6 delegates fleet processing requirements to the Petroleum Industry Processing Specifications and later applicable documents.
checks: Record external document version and applicable program.
Do not infer a fuel purchase or mandatory fleet segment solely from a Section 5 label or display name.
rules.expected: Fleet source completeness and program acceptance remain EXTERNAL_CONTRACT_REQUIRED.

rules.statement: SVC does not perform device expiry validation. Manual entry depends on authorizer; standard scanned gift cards use manual mode 01 while Blackhawk scanned transactions use swiped mode 90.
checks: Test authorizer-dependent three-swipe fallback.
Do not apply a universal manual mode to every scanned gift card.
rules.expected: Program exceptions stay explicit; exact payload and authorizer evidence are still required.

rules.statement: K activates an SVC account for a specified amount; successful activation precedes use of that account.
checks: Check configured activation amount and before/after account state.
Do not infer activation success from request format.
rules.expected: Host/state evidence establishes successful activation.

rules.statement: L deactivation and Premium Gift cash-out are product-specific: deactivation amount matches balance in the stated profile; Premium Gift cash-out is >0 and <=balance and returns the zeroing amount in Approved Amount.
checks: Preserve the source's product naming and obtain a confirmed product/profile mapping.
Check account closure versus remaining open and SV1 totals under configuration.
rules.expected: Do not turn ambiguous Standard/Premium/non-Standard naming into a universal executable rule.

rules.statement: Q recharge adds to the current balance but must not exceed the card's original value.
checks: Check exact original-value boundary and over-cap mutation using synthetic state.
rules.expected: Over-cap recharge violates the source rule; actual posting needs host evidence.

rules.statement: M merges at most two SVC balances onto one card and zeros the other; merging more cards requires repeated two-card operations.
checks: Check conservation of balance and zeroed source card.
Do not encode a single three-card merge.
rules.expected: Two-card operation semantics are separate from a repeated-operation lifecycle.

rules.statement: N transfers balance from a lost/stolen/damaged SVC to a new account and zeros the old balance.
checks: Check distinct replacement account and before/after balance evidence.
rules.expected: Card-status authority and transfer success require program/host evidence.

rules.statement: E SVC balance inquiry is information-only and must not change SVC quantity or amount totals.
checks: Compare synthetic totals before and after inquiry.
rules.expected: Returned balance is not a sale or a totals update.

rules.statement: SVC preauthorization activation/account verification is supported only for InComm; a subsequent activation is not associated with the original verification.
checks: Do not preserve generic authorization/completion correlation for this verification-to-activation sequence.
rules.expected: Do not infer all SVC account verification is a generic linked preauthorization flow.

rules.statement: SVC receipts have product-specific requirements; First Data Premium Gift masks the last four digits, unlike the general last-four-visible PAN rule.
checks: Review the applicable receipt policy and retention/redaction separately.
Do not copy credit receipt masking unchanged to every stored-value product.
rules.expected: Only approved masked/synthetic receipt examples may be used.

rules.statement: Section 10.8 lists purchase for check processing. SCAN/ECA-TeleCheck swipes require MICR; manual provider-specific identity/state/DOB fields and receipt requirements differ. Non-ECA/TeleCheck has no required receipt in this profile.
checks: Require ECA/TeleCheck authorization copies and signature workflow where applicable.
Do not generalize card PAN, expiry or receipt rules to check services.
rules.expected: Provider identity and exact contracts gate operation validation.

rules.statement: Loyalty does not perform device expiry validation; manual entry is allowed after swipe retries and missing expiry defaults to 1249 under the source profile.
checks: Keep loyalty identity and address/phone lookup distinct from payment PAN checks.
rules.expected: No blanket credit-card expiry or card-present requirement.

rules.statement: V covers add account, coupon redemption, expiration update, account inquiry, points redemption, coupon reversal, points reversal, sale update, account update and loyalty totals report.
checks: Select the exact loyalty advice function and applicable state/totals contract.
Keep D RBC loyalty lookup separate from V advice.
rules.expected: A recognized V or D code alone does not validate the operation.

rules.statement: D identifies RBC loyalty-number lookup, but Appendix G classification does not establish a complete RBC operation or request/response contract.
checks: Obtain a versioned RBC provider contract and synthetic lookup oracles.
rules.expected: EXTERNAL_CONTRACT_REQUIRED for executable lookup semantics.

rules.statement: T identifies TransArmor token registration, not universal support for every payment program. Detailed registration and security contracts must be supplied separately.
checks: Review the applicable TransArmor external source and version, token provenance and message profile.
rules.expected: EXTERNAL_CONTRACT_REQUIRED; do not manufacture real tokens or registration success.

rules.statement: Distinguish the 30-second response interval from the recommended TOR forwarding delay. A queued TOR precedes the next financial request from the same device, or settlement if none; do not impose global serialization.
checks: Preserve source-defined late-response handling, identity and per-route retries.
Exclude unsupported originals and check partial-approval amount rules.
rules.expected: Timer and route ambiguities remain review-gated; authorization hold release is not a universal TOR.

rules.statement: Receipt ID mapping is separate from receipt rendering. Apply the source-specific credit, debit, EBT, eWIC, SVC and check receipt profiles rather than assuming one Mastercard template fits all.
checks: Check merchant, transaction, amount, balance and masking requirements under the selected product.
Keep full track, PIN and sensitive authentication data out of training examples.
rules.expected: Mapping classification is not receipt-rendering or data-retention certification.

rules.statement: The 2026-3 Visa Appendix AE model distinguishes initial, incremental, completion and conditional rollover. Incrementals retain original continuity fields and do not reset the original 7/14-day category-dependent window.
checks: Review CNP/EV merchant restrictions and nonexclusive MCC scope.
Check completion before rollover and the original deadline; exact cutoff/timezone remains open.
rules.expected: Logical observations are not host messages; merchant permission, field placement and outcome evidence remain required.

rules.statement: The 2026-4 Appendix AF multi-network incremental authorization overlay is inventoried but excluded from 2026-3 teaching and executable policy until an authorized release/mapping decision.
checks: Do not substitute Appendix AF for 2026-3 Visa Appendix AE.
Keep AF Transaction ID separate from Table 82 Terminal Transaction Number until mapping is resolved.
rules.expected: REVIEW_REQUIRED release overlay, not a baseline migration or new executable all-network rule.

rules.statement: Require external issuer/card status, merchant routing, clearing, settlement and reconciliation evidence separately from ATL105 field validation.
checks: Do not report settled, active, eligible or approved solely because a format validator passed.
rules.expected: EXTERNAL_CONTRACT_REQUIRED until versioned contracts and independent execution evidence exist.
